preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 3 <= N <= 1000 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(output_lines, N_list))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Every element in the constructed array is an integer between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(any(gcd_val == i for gcd_val in [math.gcd(*sub) for sub in itertools.combinations(arr, r) for r in range(2, len(arr)+1)]) for i in range(1, N+1)) for arr, N in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines], N_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case with array A of length N, for every integer i from 1 to N, there exists a subsequence of A with length at least 2 such that the GCD of the subsequence elements equals i.
